title: warm-rule-cache
summary: Fills the lint rule cache for a project index; index runs warm it, or start it in the background (--rule-cache-warm)
intro: Computes the whole-project lint rules (circular-uses, enum-helper-separate-units, duplicate-global-decl) for a project index and stores them, so the next lint of any unit in it is a cache hit. Every project index run warms it before it returns; --rule-cache-warm background starts it in a detached process instead (the run returns at once), off skips it, and DRAGLINT_RULE_CACHE_WARM sets the default. Run it by hand when you want the cache warm right now. It needs a project index and writes only if no index changed while it ran. Contributed by Jonathas Paiva (PR #1).

help: cache for a project index now, in this process; what index starts in the background.
--detached: the form index uses -- every line of output goes to NUL)
